name: Themeslab Direct Checkout & Buy Now Button for WooCommerce
author: WP Themes Lab

sections.description:
If you want to boost your store’s conversion rate, reducing checkout friction is key. WooCommerce Buy Now Button lets customers skip the cart page entirely and go straight to checkout with a single click. By adding a direct “Buy Now” or “Quick Buy” button alongside or in place of your standard “Add to Cart” button, you dramatically shorten the purchasing path.

Whether you run a single-product store, sell landing-page style deals, or simply want to offer a faster purchasing path for returning customers, this plugin provides a robust and clean solution.

This plugin is lightweight, built specifically for speed, and hooks directly into the native WooCommerce cart flows.

Features

  • One-Click Direct Checkout Redirect: Skip the cart page and automatically redirect customers straight to the checkout page (or a custom cart page) as soon as they click the button.
  • Auto-Clear Cart Option: Choose to clear the user’s cart automatically before adding the new product. This is ideal for single-product sales or shops where customers rarely purchase multiple different items at once.
  • Custom Button Styling: Match your brand perfectly without touching any code. Customize the button text, background and text colors (including hover states), border radius, font sizes, and custom padding directly from the settings panel.
  • Smart Visibility Rules: Turn the button on or off for specific product types (e.g., only simple products), toggle by categories, or exclude specific product IDs entirely if they don’t fit your fast-checkout strategy.
  • Hide Default Button: Clean up your product pages by completely hiding the default WooCommerce “Add to Cart” button on single product pages.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the themeslab-direct-buy-now-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or search and install it directly via the WordPress Admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Buy Now Button for WooCommerce menu page in your dashboard to configure the settings.
sections.faq:
Does this support variable products?

Yes! The “Buy Now” button automatically integrates with variable products on single product pages.

Can I hide the default “Add to Cart” button?

Yes, there is an option in the settings to hide the default “Add to Cart” button on single product pages.
